summary: Austin Gold Corp. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO and CFO interim certifications, incorporated by reference into its Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. No transactional event is disclosed: cash fell to $257,564 from $573,159 at year-end, short-term investments to $1,014,191, and the nine-month net loss widened to $1,992,901 ($0.15 per share) on a $770,963 exploration write-off. Nothing for a risk-arb angle; watch going-concern language and liquidity runway.
